title: Startups @ARTPARK — ARTPARK @IISc - Leading AI & Robotics startup incubation
description: A startup incubation and accelerator program for deep-tech startups. The program enables entrepreneurs and researchers to take ideas from the lab to the market, by bridging the gap between research innovations and their application in solving day-to-day challenges, specifically in the AI and Robotics ecosystem.
text:
Startup@ARTPARK

Incubation and accelerator programs for deep-tech startups under our TBI (Technology Business Incubator)

Our Programs

ARTPARK supports deep-tech startups through two programmes — the Technology Innovators in Residence (TIR) and the Venture Incubation Programme (VIP). Applications for the current cohort are closed. Watch this space for the next cohort announcement.
